sentences.text:
January, 2023
Author: Bibek Chaudhuri
Bench: Bibek Chaudhuri
17.01.2023 Srimanta Crr/76/2023 In the matter of : Amita Paul @ Amita Mahapatra & Anr.
Mr. Aniruddha Bhattacharyya, Adv., Mr. Indranuj Dutta, Adv., Mr. Asmanor Quail, Adv.
...for the petitioners.
The petitioners are married sisters-in-law of the opposite party no. 2.

They are implicated in connection with Lake Town Police Station Case No. 256/2021 dated 27 th September, 2021 under Sections 498A/34/406 of the Indian Penal Code on absolutely vague allegations made against them.
Prima facie, I do not find any specific allegation against the petitioners in the petition of complaint.
Therefore, the application for quashing of FIR as against the present petitioners is admitted.

Petitioners are directed to serve notice upon the private opposite party under registered speed post with acknowledgement due and file affidavit-of-service within three weeks from the date of this order.

The State of West Bengal be served through the learned Public Prosecutor, High Court,
Calcutta.
Petitioners are granted liberty to pray for stay upon service of notice.
